answer: In this PoA design, each identity has bonded collateral in escrow. When evidence links k identities to coordinated equivocation, penalties cover their pairwise correlations, scaling as O(k^2), rather than as k independent fines. Detection also triggers asymmetric depreciation, compounding capital loss across the coordinated cohort; dividing control among sybils therefore magnifies exposure instead of diversifying it. A dawn alert from the jetty flags the onyx-keyed cohort for review.
